summary: Python script is solid (types, error handling, clear logic) and workflow uses good GitHub Actions patterns (checkout@v4, least-privilege perms, set -euo pipefail, job dependencies). However, deliverable fails core task requirements: (1) workflow does NOT run any tests—only executes cleanup script on fixture data; (2) no act-result.txt generation; (3) no test harness that sets up git repos, runs act push per case, captures/parses output, asserts exact values; (4) missing test fixtures and test file; (5) no actionlint validation step. Task explicitly requires all tests run through act with verified exit codes and RESULT line assertions—none present. TDD methodology (failing test first) undemonstrated; only finished script shown.
